stem: Anvi sees a poster: Class 6 has $30$ students drawn as a tall tower icon, and Class 7 has $60$ students drawn as a tower only a little taller than the Class 6 icon.

parts.text: Which claim about the poster is correct?

options.text: Trust the poster sizes, because the Class 7 icon looks appealing.
Do not trust the sizes: Class 7 has twice as many students, but its icon is not twice as tall.
Treat every decorative mark on the poster as a data claim, even marks that leave the student counts unchanged.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Accurate visuals must keep the intended numerical ratios. Twice the students should look about twice as tall; a barely taller icon distorts the data.

teacher.key_rationale: Scale must preserve the $30:60$ ratio. Appeal does not create accuracy. Pure decoration that does not change interpretation is not the data question.
